default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win19cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win19cis_rule_2_3_11_6 }}
file:
  win19cis_2_3_11_6_forcelogoffwhenhourexpire:
    title: "2.3.11.6 | Ensure 'Network security: Force logoff when logon hours expire' is set to 'Enabled' | ForceLogoffWhenHourExpire"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win19cis_snapshot_dir }}\SystemAccess.ForceLogoffWhenHourExpire'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^1$/'
    skip: {{ if eq .Vars.win19cis_system_role "standalone" }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.11.6
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-2(12)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.11.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.11/cis_2.3.11.6.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

The role skips this on domain-joined hosts, where domain policy governs it.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.11.6 | PATCH | Ensure Network security Force logoff when logon hours expire is set to Enabled"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_2_3_11_6
    - not prelim_win19cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.11.6
    - patch
    - network
    - NIST800-171_3.1.2
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_12
  community.windows.win_security_policy:
    section: System Access
    key: ForceLogoffWhenHourExpire
    value: 1
